title: OpenMoat repository policy or policy pack, schema version 1
description: A project's <project>/.moat/policy.yaml (docs/POLICY.md §10) or a signed policy pack (§11): rules that can only make the person's policy stricter until trusted. `defaults`, `executables`, `sandbox` and the person's other settings are not accepted here.
$comment: Hand-written; crates/openmoat-core/tests/policy_schema/ keeps it equal to RepoPolicy. Its sections are those of policy-v1.schema.json.

not.description: A file with both `ask:` and `review:` is an error.

version.description: The policy schema version (ADR-103); only 1 exists.

deny.description: Joins the person's deny rules, under `repo:` (or `pack:<name>:`) ids.

allow.description: Applies only once the file is trusted (`openmoat trust`, or a signature), after the person's allow rules.

review.description: Tried after the person's deny rules and before their allow rules.

ask.description: The name of `review:` before 0.14.0 (ADR-053): still read, never written.

require.description: Raises the protection level an agent must be at in the project, trusted or not; never lowers it.

requests.description: Request rules (§2.3): `deny` lists only, which narrow, trusted or not.

not.description: An `allow` list belongs in the person's own policy.
